notes.title: Update 5524
notes.notes:
Update 5524
- Fixed an error with a stairs in few apartments.
- Added "drug dealer apartment". Look for the door key to see what it hides !!

notes.title: PIVERANTUM UPDATE DEV
notes.notes:
Piverantum is now complete, the play testers are carrying out the final checks before publication.
The game now supports controllers and STEAM DECK.

Modifications to the apartments and a new weapon have been made.

In this game as in all Laboriontech games, you cannot kill people.
